requirements.heading: 1. Product / current baseline
requirements.item: 1.1 Census, encounters, findings, procedures, STAT, handoff and history
requirements.evidence: clinical-rounding-adaptive.html: openModal, savePatient, renderMainTable, generateHandoff; USP.md
requirements.caveat: Code present in clinical-rounding-adaptive.html and supporting JS; no running deployment verified. Behavior must be characterized for SaaS migration.
requirements.requirement: Preserve core rounding behavior through characterization and clinical acceptance.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic golden journeys; visit history/backfeed excludes fresh findings; clinician sign-off.

requirements.heading: 1. Product / source of truth
requirements.caveat: Multiple artifacts present (root vs. release); Firebase instructions outdated. Single canonical source not yet established.
requirements.requirement: Record canonical product/version, alternatives and supported artifact manifest.
requirements.acceptance: Approved inventory and diff; no changes to PoC during planning; one future release source of truth.

requirements.heading: 1. Product / customers
requirements.item: 1.3 Intended use, buyer and commercial scope
requirements.caveat: Documented intended use (USP.md, exec brief); no validated buyer requirement or pilot contract.
requirements.requirement: Choose specialty-practice rounding wedge; define exclusions, pilot agreement and success criteria.
requirements.acceptance: Buyer interviews, named decision-maker, clinical safety review, pilot acceptance contract; no valuation target.

requirements.heading: 2. Refactor / frontend
requirements.evidence: clinical-rounding-adaptive.html: savePatient, renderUI, setTab, Device; import-engine.js
requirements.caveat: Monolithic HTML demonstrates working UI/UX; modularization and framework choice pending technical spike.
requirements.requirement: Extract forms/domain services, typed API boundary and mobile components incrementally; framework decision after spike.
requirements.acceptance: Characterization regressions pass; accessible phone/tablet flows, no PHI in fixtures.

requirements.heading: 2. Refactor / services
requirements.evidence: api/patients/index.js; api/backfeed/index.js; api/settings/index.js; api/onCallSchedule/index.js; api/export/index.js; api/shared/dataService.js; staticwebapp.config.json
requirements.caveat: API routes and role checks present (api/patients/index.js lines 33-39); existing checks require tenant-scoped authorization verification and server-side enforcement testing.
requirements.requirement: Validate requests, trusted identity and tenant-scoped access server-side; contract/version tests, idempotency and optimistic concurrency.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-tenant negative tests on every method including export; malformed requests denied; replay/concurrency tests; no header trust without gateway validation.

requirements.heading: 3. Identity / tenant data
requirements.caveat: Current M365 config is single site/list per deployment; tenant isolation model and membership lifecycle not yet designed.
requirements.requirement: Tenant lifecycle, verified organization membership, per-resource authorization, invitation/revocation and admin separation.
requirements.acceptance: Two synthetic tenants cannot enumerate/read/write/export each other; offboarding revokes access.

requirements.heading: 3. Identity / tenant data
requirements.item: 3.2 Patient and encounter identity, schema and indexes
requirements.caveat: VisitKey pattern (MRN|date) exists in code; not globally unique across organizations. Tenant+source scoping to be designed.
requirements.requirement: Design tenant+source/facility-scoped patient IDs and encounter IDs; constraints, migrations, indexes and retention.
requirements.acceptance: Same MRN/date in two organizations remains isolated; multiple encounters/day policy; reversible migration and query plans.

requirements.heading: 3. Identity / tenant data
requirements.item: 3.3 Cache, offline, conflict and session policy
requirements.evidence: m365-integration.js: startPolling, fetchAllData, localStorage cache, triggerServerSessionInvalidation; clinical-rounding-adaptive.html
requirements.caveat: Polling/localStorage/session invalidation code present; tenant isolation, cache purge, and conflict handling not verified.
requirements.requirement: Explicit offline/PHI policy, tenant-aware cache purge, session timeout, conflict detection and safe retries.
requirements.acceptance: Shared-browser tenant switch, lost-device/logout/cache purge, expired session and stale write tests.

requirements.heading: 4. Migration / interoperability
requirements.evidence: m365-integration.js: api_fetchPatients, api_savePatient, api_fetchOnCallSchedule, api_fetchSettings; api/shared/dataService.js
requirements.caveat: Graph API calls and field mapping logic present in m365-integration.js; source schema snapshot and field mapping verification pending.
requirements.requirement: Version source schema manifest and export mapping; map internal field names/types/nulls/timezones/VisitKey to SaaS IDs.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic sample export with findings/codes/values, archive, on-call, settings, document links; signed mapping and exceptions.

requirements.heading: 4. Migration / interoperability
requirements.evidence: import-engine.js; clinical-rounding-adaptive.html: previewBulkImport, proceedBulkImport; m365-integration.js: exportToOneDrive, api_uploadPatientFile, api_fetchPatientFiles
requirements.caveat: Bulk import/export logic present (import-engine.js, m365-integration.js); production-level validation, limits, and authorization not verified.
requirements.requirement: Retain preview/dedup/resume semantics with server validation; tenant object storage, signed downloads, safe CSV/XLSX exports and malware policy.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic duplicate/corrupt/large-file/retry tests; formula-injection controls; no cross-tenant document access or public PHI links.

requirements.heading: 4. Migration / interoperability
requirements.caveat: No migration runbook, reconciliation tools, or cutover procedures currently documented. Requires design and testing.
requirements.requirement: Synthetic rehearsals; counts, canonical hashes and per-field reconciliation; staged tenant cutover with source write pause and rollback.
requirements.acceptance: 100% explained record/field exceptions; restore rehearsal; signed go/no-go, rollback trigger and elapsed window; no uncontrolled dual-write.

requirements.heading: 4. Migration / interoperability
requirements.item: 4.4 PoC coexistence, retirement and exit portability
requirements.caveat: Current GitHub Pages deployment separate from planned SaaS. Customer exit/retention policies not yet defined.
requirements.requirement: Keep PoC read-only or separately owned per cutover plan; customer export/exit, retention and deletion policy.
requirements.acceptance: Accountable source-of-record per tenant; reconcile final export; no deletion until rollback/retention approvals; customer exit tested.

requirements.heading: 5. Trust / compliance
requirements.evidence: .kiro/specs/healthcare-compliance/requirements.md; design.md; tasks.md; api/patients/index.js: logAudit; m365-integration.js: api_logAuditEvent
requirements.caveat: Compliance specification and task checklist present (.kiro/specs/); spec checkboxes are requirements, not evidence of implementation. Audit calls present in code but independent control verification required.
requirements.requirement: Threat model, privacy minimization, attributable tamper-resistant audit, access review, retention and qualified regulatory/BAA assessment.
requirements.acceptance: Audit read/write/export/admin coverage and protected retention tests; counsel-approved agreements and service eligibility; no automatic SOX mandate.

requirements.heading: 5. Trust / compliance
requirements.item: 5.2 Independent review and approved customer pilot
requirements.caveat: No independent pen-test, clinical safety review, or legal/BAA approval conducted. Required before customer PHI use.
requirements.requirement: Clinical safety acceptance, independent penetration test/retest, contracts, data-handling approval and incident response before customer PHI.
requirements.acceptance: No unaccepted critical findings; documented residual risk; clinical/technical/legal sign-offs; customer pilot stop rules.

requirements.heading: 6. Delivery / operations
requirements.item: 6.1 Automated characterization, contracts and release gates
requirements.evidence: api/package.json: test echoes No tests yet; docs/testing/E2E_UI_TEST_SEQUENCE_TEEN.md; docs/testing/New E2E.md; tools/diagnostics/
requirements.caveat: Manual test guides and diagnostics present; api/package.json shows "No tests yet" placeholder. CI/CD gates and automated test suite not implemented.
requirements.requirement: Practical CI unit/integration/e2e, tenant isolation, import round-trip, mobile and restore tests; reviewed PRs and staged deployment.
requirements.acceptance: Repeatable synthetic pipeline, meaningful failures, evidence retained per release, dependency/secrets scans and rollback drill.

requirements.heading: 6. Delivery / operations
requirements.caveat: staticwebapp.config.json and API hosting config present; no multi-environment (dev/stage/prod) isolation or managed infrastructure deployment verified.
requirements.requirement: Managed modular monolith; dev/stage/prod, relational DB, object storage, worker/queue, secrets, identity, edge/WAF and IaC review.
requirements.acceptance: Documented SKU/region/replicas, isolation and budgets; mutually exclusive Azure/AWS choice; no production PHI in nonprod.

requirements.heading: 6. Delivery / operations
requirements.item: 6.3 Backup, recovery, telemetry and incident operations
requirements.caveat: Error handling and retry logic present in code; backup strategy, recovery procedures, and SLA targets not yet designed.
requirements.requirement: Proposed pilot RPO 24h/RTO 8h, growth RPO 1h/RTO 4h subject to quote/test; PHI-free logging, alerting and incident runbooks.
requirements.acceptance: Timed restore test, deletion-retention review, on-call coverage, incident tabletop and cost/ingestion alert drill.

requirements.heading: 6. Delivery / operations
requirements.evidence: clinical-rounding-adaptive.html: settings; m365-integration.js: settings APIs; USP.md
requirements.caveat: Settings form logic present in clinical-rounding-adaptive.html; tenant provisioning, subscription lifecycle, and onboarding backend not implemented.
requirements.requirement: Tenant onboarding/admin, subscription lifecycle, entitlement checks, invoicing, support/escalation and account offboarding.
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic invoice/failed payment/cancel/refund, role invitation/revocation and onboarding playbook; support ownership staffed.

requirements.heading: 6. Delivery / operations
requirements.caveat: No measured SaaS throughput, concurrent-user tests, or cost-per-tenant analysis. Scaling decisions deferred pending pilot data.
requirements.requirement: Measure concurrent rounding/imports and cost per tenant; resize from observed SLO, optimize queries/jobs before distribution.
requirements.acceptance: Representative load and noisy-neighbor tests, p95/queue/DB alarms; repeat deployment and pilot feedback gate before growth hires.

requirements.heading: 7. Optional expansions
requirements.caveat: AI_USP.md and AI_AUGMENTATION_OPTIONS.md document exploratory ideas and provider options; no AI implementation, evaluation, or approval. Deferred post-approval pilot.
requirements.requirement: Narrow assistive use case, synthetic eval, sources/provenance, human review, privacy/contract/endpoint approval, cost limits and fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Approved evaluation thresholds, no unapproved PHI, provider review, prompt-injection and safety tests; no automatic clinical decision.

requirements.heading: 7. Optional expansions
requirements.caveat: CTMS executive brief documents potential expansion; no research buyer demand validation, study/site model design, or separate business case. Deferred pending Core MVP success.
requirements.requirement: Separate study/site/subject model, protocol and milestone workflows, permissions, sponsor/CRO buyer research, EDC/eTMF integrations and scope-specific validation/e-signatures.
requirements.acceptance: Research stakeholder validation, data/licensing agreements, intended-use and regulatory assessment, separate synthetic pilot and go/no-go investment case.

wbs.work: API validation, trusted identity integration, server authorization, concurrency and contract tests

wbs.work: Synthetic rehearsal, count/canonical-hash/field reconciliation, write-pause cutover and rollback drills

wbs.work: Threat model, audit design/retention/access, privacy minimization and legal applicability assessment
wbs.decision: Reuse specs as requirements; verify implementation and operation

wbs.work: Independent pen-test/retest, clinical safety and legal/data-handling customer-pilot approval
wbs.decision: External independent assessment; remediation labor already staffed
wbs.acceptance: No unaccepted critical findings from independent review; documented residual risks; written legal/security/clinical pilot approval

wbs.work: Characterization automation, CI contracts/e2e/tenant tests, review/release evidence gates
wbs.decision: Refactor manual tests into automated assurance; placeholder not evidence
wbs.acceptance: Failing-regression demo and green staged release

wbs.work: Managed environments, IaC, identity/secrets, DB/object/queue, WAF and cost budgets
wbs.decision: Choose Azure OR AWS; modular monolith before microservices

wbs.work: Restore/recovery rehearsal, PHI-free observability, incident tabletop and service targets

wbs.work: Tenant provisioning, entitlements/subscriptions, billing admin, onboarding and support playbooks
wbs.decision: New SaaS capability; billing codes are not subscription billing

wbs.work: Pilot feedback, load/noisy-neighbor tests, query/job tuning and repeatable deploys before growth
wbs.decision: Measure before scaling; defer Kubernetes and EHR integrations
wbs.acceptance: SLO/cost evidence, repeat onboarding and release

wbs.work: Optional assistive AI discovery/eval, provider approval, human review UX and monitored synthetic pilot
wbs.decision: Defer by default; separately staffed and token-metered
wbs.acceptance: Evaluation, privacy, cost and clinical sign-offs

wbs.work: Optional CTMS discovery, study/site model, research integrations and scope-dependent validation/e-signatures
wbs.decision: Defer by default; separate product case, not relabeling rounding
wbs.acceptance: Research buyer evidence and independent go/no-go

risks.risk: Wrong first buyer or scope; rounding/CTMS conflation
risks.mitigation: Paid-pilot problem discovery; separate CTMS investment case; no valuation reverse engineering
risks.likelihood: High; rounding-only vs. CTMS scope unclear in market

risks.risk: Cross-tenant access or identity boundary failure
risks.mitigation: Trusted auth, per-resource checks, negative isolation tests, independent review and incident drills
risks.likelihood: High impact; multi-tenant isolation is critical blocker

risks.risk: Migration data loss or hidden field incompatibility
risks.mitigation: Schema manifest, synthetic rehearsal, count/hash/field reconciliation, write pause, staged cutover and rollback

risks.risk: Clinical safety or validation evidence insufficient
risks.mitigation: Intended-use scope, synthetic edge cases, clinician acceptance, customer approval and stop rules
risks.likelihood: High impact; regulatory applicability must be established before customer use

risks.risk: Incorrect regulatory applicability / contracts / cloud eligibility
risks.mitigation: Review HIPAA/BAA/service eligibility and state privacy rules; SOX not assumed; research e-signature/validation scope-specific
risks.likelihood: Unresolved; BAA scope and cloud residency rules not yet evaluated

risks.risk: Hiring timing, blended roles and key-person dependence
risks.mitigation: Confirm actual availability, contractor agreements and onboarding; capacity-level WBS before commitment; dates do not automatically compress
risks.cost: STAFF / EQUIPMENT; recruiting modeled per incremental FTE

risks.risk: Sales procurement/onboarding lead time and churn exceed forecasts
risks.mitigation: Track cohorts and buying process; zero-revenue cash sensitivity; quarterly reforecast before growth hires
